C-HUB-REG-PAGES.IntentSummary: Execute the approved spec C-HUB-REG-PAGES: give every entry of the regulation page its own short, practical page in Russian and English, linked from its card, with key ideas and where to read more outside.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: A page content/ru/reference/regulation/<id>.md (and its English twin) is built under the Справочник without its own menu item; the build gives it a header line from acts.yaml (back link, kind, jurisdiction, weight tag) and the not-a-legal-opinion note; its card on the regulation page links to it.
A test fails when an entry of acts.yaml has no page or a page has no entry.

Each entry has a Russian page in the spec's structure, researched from official and reputable sources listed under «Где читать», short and practical; and its English twin through the translation workflow (term list, source_hash).
Corrections to existing cards found in research are reported with their source.

T-003.Title: Source links, browser check, packages, publishing

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Every outside address on the new pages answers; the browser sweep of both editions passes; the offline packages include the pages; on the owner's word they are published and checked on the server.
